_readme: Config for fetch_sources.py. Only sources confirmed public-domain in /Users/Apple/Desktop/Nous/projects/mihira/research/public-domain-source-texts.md are listed. sacred-texts.com is deliberately excluded — its robots.txt explicitly disallows ClaudeBot. GRETIL (Sanskrit) and archive.org (English translations) have no such restriction and archive.org's whole mission is bulk reuse of public-domain texts. Entries marked 'verified' have a confirmed working URL/identifier; entries marked 'todo' need identifier lookup via find_archive_identifier.py before use — do not guess identifiers, a wrong one will silently fetch the wrong book.
